olivia (docs): opening a small PR to tidy the SDK examples: streaming (async iterators), pagination (cursor example), and a tiny retries snippet. also fixing a dead link to the retry guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/704

raj (eng): thanks 1 I'll review Python + TS. are these purely docs changes?

sam (sdk): will take Go and skim the TS. confirm naming: stream_generate for py, streamGenerate for TS/Go?

olivia (docs): yes, keep idiomatic names. no behaviour changes, just examples and a one-line note about streaming caveats.

marta (qa): can we add a one-step harness that runs each example for a single iteration? async streaming tends to regress quietly.

olivia (docs): added a tiny harness script in the PR description that runs each example and exits 0/1. pasted compact snippets below for review.

olivia (docs): ```python
# python: streaming + retry minimal
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client()
async def once():
    async for chunk in client.stream_generate("Summarize this paragraph", max_tokens=80, retry_policy={"backoff": "exponential", "max_retries": 2}):
        print(chunk.text)
        break
asyncio.run(once())
```

olivia (docs): ```ts
// typescript: streaming minimal
const s = client.streamGenerate({ prompt: 'Summarize this paragraph', maxTokens: 80 });
for await (const c of s) { console.log(c.text); break }
// note: very short outputs may be coalesced by the transport
```

olivia (docs): ```go
// go: cursor-based pagination minimal
ctx := context.Background()
iter := client.ListEmbeddings(ctx, &redwood.ListEmbeddingsRequest{PageSize: 20})
if iter.Next() {
    _ = iter.Item()
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
    // report / retry
}
// note: next_cursor is empty at EOF
```

sam (sdk): pushed a tiny Go comment clarifying the next_cursor/EOF behaviour. also added a one-line example of honoring context cancellation.

marta (qa): running harness now. quick note: TS buffering varies with short prompts; I added a single-line caveat in the TS snippet. harness passed locally and on preview.
